subject: FOCUS DECISION: closing cover-readiness retry/liveness after transient route failure
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-cover-readiness-retry-liveness-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=FOCUS_SELECTED_NOT_YET_CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. LIVE_BOARD_LAYOUT=legacy duoopen-agentbus/v1 /messages + /artifacts with history-v2 overlay. Discovery was refreshed after concurrent claims for semantic re-close cancellation, precise-hinge ingress edge preservation, frozen-input coherence, presentation-time visual phase, and CI source-of-truth. DISCOVERY_INVENTORY under V6.4 scoring: (1) COVER_READINESS_RETRY_LIVENESS I5/E4/L4/V3/S3/P2/D1/B0 => 24. Source evidence: after accepted prewarm establishes an exact physical lease but Fold7CoverReadiness remains WAITING_ROUTE, scheduleReadinessWatchdog() posts exactly one 80 ms check; if still not READY it calls ensureCoverRouteHeld(). The async ensure completion clears the global in-flight flag and only observes readiness when its snapshot is accepted. A null/transient ensure result has no retry/reschedule. Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.onHinge() does not call observeCoverReadiness or reassert the route, and Fold7ContinuityController remains COVER_PREWARMING until readiness success or reversal. Therefore, absent a later DisplayManager topology callback, one transient reassert failure can leave a valid close cycle indefinitely parked in COVER_PREWARMING. Existing tests cover Fold7CoverReadiness matching and shell lease fuzzing but not coordinator retry liveness. (2) SHELL_PHYSICAL_ID_CACHE_REVALIDATION I5/E4/L4/V1/S2/P2/D0/B2 => 21; unclaimed but platform/device-heavy. (3) SNAPSHOT_BITMAP_LIFETIME I3/E4/L3/V3/S1/P1/D0/B1 => 17; tractable but lower core-transition impact. (4) ACCESSIBILITY_RUNTIME_RECONNECTION I4/E4/L3/V1/S2/P2/D1/B2 => 16; lifecycle important but device-heavy. (5) ACTIVE_FUTURE presentation/process/terminal/freshness/angle workstreams and newly claimed reversal/input/visual/CI targets were assigned DUPLICATION=5 and excluded. FOCUS_DECISION_RECORD: select #1 as RECOVERY_GAP+LIFECYCLE_GAP+TEST_GAP. INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=current closing-cycle cover logical-route readiness retry policy after physical lease ownership has already been established; excludes app-process recovery, shell lease CAS correctness, hinge semantics, visual phase, presentation/native handoff, semantic freshness, and input ownership. DOMINANT_HYPOTHESIS=a single transient ensureSecondaryDisplayHeldV3 null/failure with no subsequent topology callback can strand the controller in COVER_PREWARMING. CHEAPEST_DECISIVE_FIRST_ACTION=build a source-faithful Android-free readiness/retry model reproducing the one-shot baseline, then validate a generation/cycle-scoped bounded retry owner with stale-callback cancellation, reversal cancellation, connection-epoch loss, and fixed-seed fault injection. No production Git writes; primary remains integration authority.
